claim: The sample uses a separate demo log and leaves the user's log untouched.
where: home action note, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record; enter, change, reset, and leave demo; assert real data remains and demo storage is deleted

claim: The log reloads offline after the first visit.
where: home facts, connectivity notice, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker control; set context offline; reload and assert sample data and offline state

claim: The log exports every record as JSON and CSV and restores a valid JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; verify generated JSON and CSV contents; add a record; restore the JSON and assert the extra record is removed

claim: Practice blocks can be created, linked, edited, and deleted; blank text and impossible dates are rejected.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; reject whitespace and nine minutes; save 60 minutes; reject an earlier use; link, edit, preserve the link, and delete

claim: A license check sends only the license token and never sends log content.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; intercept the billing API; verify a sample token; assert the single request contains the token and no sample record text

claim: The interface supports automatic, light, and dark themes with keyboard and mobile access.
sandbox: fresh browser context; axe-scan light and dark; test all mobile targets, keyboard focus, effective 200% zoom, and legal routes

claim: The app notifies an open page when a new service worker finishes installing.
sandbox: simulated controlled registration; dispatch the first updatefound and installed events; assert one notification with that worker

claim: Normal logging needs no account or analytics and sends no record data away.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; monitor the whole create-and-link flow; assert no cross-origin or non-GET request and confirm no-account copy

claim: Weekly logging and exports are free; the optional archive review costs US $12 once.
where: home facts, paid section, data dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context without a license; assert logging and both exports are available and the optional pass copy and hosted checkout URL show $12 once
